name: career-personality-v1
description: 来自 GitHub 开源项目 deep-personality-oss 的 Big Five/IPIP 15 题短量表；题干为中文翻译，保留 source_text 便于追溯。仅用于职业准备与自我复盘，不用于临床诊断或录用结论。

questions.category: 心理/性格测评 · Big Five
questions.title: 我在聚会或多人场合中通常是活跃气氛的人。
questions.source_text: I am the life of the party.
questions.explanation: IPIP Big Five 外向性条目。

questions.category: 心理/性格测评 · Big Five
questions.title: 我很能体会他人的感受。
questions.source_text: I sympathize heavily with others' feelings.
questions.explanation: IPIP Big Five 宜人性条目。

questions.category: 心理/性格测评 · Big Five
questions.title: 我会马上完成待办事项和任务。
questions.source_text: I get chores and tasks done right away.
questions.explanation: IPIP Big Five 尽责性条目。

questions.category: 心理/性格测评 · Big Five
questions.title: 我经常出现情绪波动。
questions.explanation: IPIP Big Five 神经质/情绪反应条目；结果按情绪反应性维度呈现。

questions.category: 心理/性格测评 · Big Five
questions.title: 我想象力丰富，脑中经常有抽象的想法。
questions.source_text: I have a vivid imagination and am full of abstract ideas.
questions.explanation: IPIP Big Five 开放性条目。

questions.category: 心理/性格测评 · Big Five
questions.title: 在社交场合中，我更愿意待在不显眼的位置。
questions.source_text: I prefer to keep in the background in social situations.
questions.explanation: IPIP Big Five 外向性反向条目。

questions.category: 心理/性格测评 · Big Five
questions.title: 我对别人的问题并不太感兴趣。
questions.source_text: I am not really interested in other people's problems.
questions.explanation: IPIP Big Five 宜人性反向条目。

questions.category: 心理/性格测评 · Big Five
questions.title: 我经常忘记把东西放回原处，或把环境弄得很乱。
questions.source_text: I often forget to put things back in their proper place or leave things a mess.
questions.explanation: IPIP Big Five 尽责性反向条目。

questions.category: 心理/性格测评 · Big Five
questions.title: 大多数时候，我都很放松、情绪稳定。
questions.source_text: I am relaxed and emotionally stable most of the time.
questions.explanation: IPIP Big Five 神经质反向条目；结果按情绪反应性维度呈现。

questions.category: 心理/性格测评 · Big Five
questions.title: 我对抽象想法或哲学讨论不太感兴趣。
questions.source_text: I am not very interested in abstract ideas or philosophical discussions.
questions.explanation: IPIP Big Five 开放性反向条目。

questions.category: 心理/性格测评 · Big Five
questions.title: 在社交聚会中，我会和很多不同的人交谈。
questions.source_text: I talk to a lot of different people at social gatherings.
questions.explanation: IPIP Big Five 外向性条目。

questions.category: 心理/性格测评 · Big Five
questions.title: 我喜欢秩序和严格的日常安排。
questions.source_text: I like order and strict routines.
questions.explanation: IPIP Big Five 尽责性条目。

questions.category: 心理/性格测评 · Big Five
questions.title: 我很容易感到不安或压力。
questions.source_text: I get upset or stressed out easily.
questions.explanation: IPIP Big Five 神经质/情绪反应条目；结果按情绪反应性维度呈现。

questions.category: 心理/性格测评 · Big Five
questions.title: 我能感受到他人的情绪，仿佛那也是自己的情绪。
questions.source_text: I feel other people's emotions almost as if they were my own.
questions.explanation: IPIP Big Five 宜人性条目。

questions.category: 心理/性格测评 · Big Five
questions.title: 我很难理解高度抽象的概念。
questions.source_text: I have difficulty understanding highly abstract concepts.
questions.explanation: IPIP Big Five 开放性反向条目。
